cases.statement: A preserves actual kind, schema family, revision, complete pin, bytes and full typed native catalog without a construction schema claim.
Native family follows exact SpecificationId grammar; duplicate stored family/revision values agree and plain SHA256 binds complete canonical bytes.
C queries only the actual Context modules by exact named Slot/Family/Root; no global, latest, schema-universe or construction-cache fallback.
Current lookup requires unique full canonical root and complete actual acyclic imported-definition closure; malformed candidate ambiguity rejects before native context assembly.
Current TypeSchemaRef contains actual specification_id, type_name and sha256/type-schema HashV1 of complete canonical root; catalog checksum is not schema identity.
NotReached, Missing, Ambiguous, FamilyMismatch, applicable RevisionMismatch, Found, Invalid and Valid have separate closed typed payloads and actual stage applicability.
Valid requires actual full native catalog semantic canonicalization and current-schema encode/decode/native-catalog equality and exact byte round-trip; Found alone is not Valid.

Each of effect_resource, recovery_usage and flow_execution has its exact closed native type/family/root association and independent Some/None validation; absent snapshots are not positive relation evidence.
Analysis and canonical_validation refer to the same actual nine-member native Context object; equal contents or digests never establish aliases and no resolver is invented.
Every actual Some requires C Valid for the relation portion of complete Subject admission; preserve actual source and failure otherwise without issuing a Fact or rewriting port verdicts.

A source and C observation retain distinct identities; Raw Source/Origin/Basis/Witness/Contradiction/EvidenceRef share the exact Subject while Raw Target and port coordinates retain their actual meanings.
Immutable source/context inputs cannot reference their derived validation/admission/Fact outputs; outputs only reference prior inputs and retain minimal reachable typed DAG rules.
Equal legacy snapshots remain equal; missing construction provenance is unavailable and cannot be recovered from a new edition, current schema, revision or checksum.
New Analysis/Model/Report/Obligation require exact new registered compiler contents; old and mixed tuples reject without relabeling and all old normative records remain exact.
Registered relation Metadata Admission never enables complete Raw, Scope, Normalizer, publication or Checked RootExport; default D0 limits and explicit bounded D4 denial remain separate.
Every new source/result/field/variant and required association has a closed nominal descriptor and executed registration coverage; shape success is not actual lookup or producer conformance.
